text:
Sam: Heads-up: planning a schema migration on accounts schema — add `billing_currency` index + backfill of historical rows. Target change window: Tue 2026-03-24 02:00 UTC. Need preflight checklist, canary plan, and a clear abort/rollback path. Who's available for the 02:00 slot?
Anya: I can own rollout. Request: pin frontend/backend to `v3.12.1` for the window, canary at 1% users, then 10% after green. Set DB lock timeout to 30s and enable statement_timeout on the migration session.
Jia: Preflight commands I'll run on staging: 
```
pg_dump -s -t accounts prod | grep billing_currency || true
psql -c "SELECT count(*) FROM accounts WHERE billing_currency IS NULL;"
```
Backfill plan: `python backfill.py --batch-size 500 --throttle qps=20 --resume-token file://backfill.token` — will emit progress every 5m.
Neal: Ops checklist: verify replica lag < 5s before starting canary. Fail criteria: any replica lag > 20s during canary OR tail p95 latency jump > 300ms. If fail, immediate abort and unapply any in-flight backfill batches. Also prepare `pg_rewind` docs if we need to promote.
Ops Oncall: noted — I'll watch replicas and DB metrics. I'll also prepare a quick runbook entry to toggle the feature flag `accounts_billing_v2` off for rollback.
Sam: Add one more safety: add a canary DB role with read-only access to the new index creation step, run index creation with `CONCURRENTLY` to avoid heavy locks. Also please open a deploy holdpoint: we need explicit +1 from Ops Oncall and Neal before promoting beyond 1%.
Anya: Agreed. I'll update the release notes fragment and pin the release in the deploy pipeline. Release notes snippet: "Adds billing_currency index to speed up currency lookups; backfill adds missing values from invoice history; opt-in via `accounts_billing_v2` feature flag."
DeployBot: migration scheduled: migration-2214567890 at 2026-03-24T02:00:00Z. To cancel: `/deploy cancel migration-2214567890`. To mark holdpoint: `/deploy hold migration-2214567890 reason=<text>`.
Jia: I'll also add a small validation query post-backfill: `SELECT count(*) FROM accounts WHERE billing_currency IS NULL;` should be 0 for canary tenant set. Run on each canary cohort and log to S3.
Neal: If any rollback: steps = 1) stop backfill, 2) enable feature flag off, 3) run compensating job to revert partial writes (we have idempotent revert script), 4) restore from snapshot only if data corruption, otherwise avoid restore.
Ops Oncall: Onboarding note for oncall: watch for increased `update` row locks during `CONCURRENTLY` index creation — set alert for `pg_stat_activity` state 'waiting' > 30s.
Sam: OK — final request: add a staged rollout with automated holdpoint after canary: the pipeline should pause and post here for manual +1. I'll update the deployment ticket with these steps and the pinned versions.
(10:12) Anya: I'll be on standby during the window.
(10:25) DeployBot: Reminder scheduled 2026-03-24T02:00:00Z for migration-2214567890 — holdpoint active until manual release.
(11:45) Ops Oncall: Quick update — in preflight warm-up on staging we saw secondaries lag spike to ~40s for a short period during a noisy analytic job. I'm going to add a pre-start quiesce for analytics for the window. Recommend we keep holdpoint until after a second warm-up at low qps.
Neal: Holdpoint acknowledged, moving to paused state. Do not promote.
DeployBot: migration-2214567890 paused by Neal — reason: secondary lag observed during preflight. To cancel: `/deploy cancel migration-2214567890`.
Sam: Thanks — good catch. Let's reconvene after the second warm-up. If warm-up is clean, Ops Oncall + Neal will clear holdpoint.
(2214571490) Ops Oncall: After re-run at qps=5, lag stayed <5s. I'm comfortable clearing holdpoint. Leaving final +1 to Neal.
Neal: +1, clear to proceed to 1% canary when pipeline sees 02:00 UTC. Remember abort criteria and rollback steps.
Sam: Great — I'll flip the pipeline out of holdpoint at T-20m and monitor. :thumbsup:
